# proxmox_node_disk_lvm (Resource)

Creates an LVM volume group on one node through `/nodes/{node}/disks/lvm` and waits for the worker task. **Proxmox wipes the device.** Destroy removes the volume group, its storage config and the data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_disk_lvm" "vg" {
  node   = "pve-1"
  name   = "vg1"
  device = "/dev/disk/by-id/ata-..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Block device such as `/dev/disk/by-id/...`. **Proxmox wipes it.**
- `name` (String) Volume group name; also the created storage id. Changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Cluster node that owns the disk. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Create a Proxmox LVM storage entry. The Proxmox default is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<name>` form.
